stories.title: Skubal hears cheers, some boos in Detroit return
stories.summary: Tarik Skubal heard mostly cheers and some jeers in his first start in Detroit since he was traded to the Dodgers and treated the Comerica Park crowd to six dominant innings against his former team Friday.

stories.title: Clark, Mitchell drop dual 34-point nights in rout
stories.summary: Caitlin Clark and Kelsey Mitchell dominated the action for the Fever on Friday night, lighting up the Sun with 34 points apiece in a 111-91 rout.

stories.title: Avs' Makar agrees to largest deal in NHL history
stories.summary: Cale Makar has agreed to an eight-year extension with the Avalanche that will make him the highest-paid player in NHL history with a $20.4 million AAV.

stories.title: Judge: SEC can't punish teams that play ex-pros
stories.summary: A temporary restraining order prohibits the SEC from enforcing a new rule that threatens stiff penalties for any team that uses a player who previously signed a contract to play in the NFL, NBA or WNBA.

stories.title: Florida's Golden gets another extension and raise
stories.summary: Todd Golden's third raise in as many years with the Florida Gators will make him the second-highest-paid basketball coach in the Southeastern Conference.
